summary: I wrote 10 browser checks for the 8 criteria. 6 passed and 4 failed. There is no backend, so the API lane was skipped (frontend-only mock prototype). The preview URL returned HTTP 429 after many runs, so the later reruns used localhost:3000. Mock state resets on reload, so seeded data was only changed in memory.

bugs.title: AI status line is truncated at 1440 (and even at 1920)
bugs.criterion: JRN-134/135/137 Inbox opens on Needs you
bugs.evidence: Check p11-inbox-needs-you. The status line renders '128 by AI today · 7 need you · 9 in progr…' with an ellipsis at 1440x900. Screenshot p11-inbox-needs-you-needs-you.png. The 1920 screenshot in p11-saved-views also shows it cut off. There is no backend (mock app), so this is frontend-only.

bugs.title: Conversation pane is only 392px wide at 1024 (the spec says ≥480)
bugs.evidence: Checks p11-inbox-needs-you and p12-blend-tablet. At 1024x800 on GB-1076, the [aria-label=Conversation] width is 392 (it is ≥480 at 1440). In screenshot p12-blend-tablet-1024.png the header meta row is clipped (the customer name is missing before '· Email', and 'Assig…' is cut off). 'Write my own' is pushed out of the draft action row.

bugs.title: GB-1076 'Why you're here' brief and Ask Goorin AI facts contradict the draft and summary
bugs.evidence: Check p11-brief-thread-header. why-brief-did reads 'drafted a reply at 53% confidence', but the draft card shows 'Draft by Claude · 58% confidence' (the seed says 58%). The brief also says 'Found 2 Loop returns ($186.00 refunded)', while the summary Returns row shows Loop $58.00. Check p11-askai-shortcuts: the refund answer also quotes $186 and never $58.

bugs.title: GB-1076 Returns row shows 13.3%, but the seed and spec say 12.3%
bugs.evidence: Check p11-summary-orders: summary-returns = 'Loop 2 · $58.00 · 13.3% of spend'. api/loop.ts computes dollars/lifetimeSpend = 58/436 = 13.3%. Either the spec or the seed's lifetime spend is wrong.

bugs.title: The Approve & send toast says 'Draft approved and sent', not 'Reply sent'
bugs.evidence: Check p11-draft-editor passes on behaviour. The toast copy comes from DraftCard/ConversationPane: 'Draft approved and sent'. 'Reply sent' is used only for composer sends.

notes: The ticket header shows both a 'Needs you' pill and a 'Needs human' status pill. This may be redundant; check it against the spec.
GB-1076 is the last ticket in Needs you. The › button (ticket-next) is not disabled on it, and pressing → does nothing. ← and ‹ work.
The AI handling view has 9 tickets with the states Replying and Waiting on customer. No 'Resolved by AI today' card was seen in that view.
In the collapsed rail on GB-1064 no red risk indicator was detected (the probe was weak, not a confirmed failure). The ']' toggle and persistence across tickets work.

Dashboard drift that is probably date-relative mock data: Tickets created 1,119 (Email 674 · Chat 445) against the seed's 1,117/1,118, and CSAT response rate 32.8% against 32.9%. All other KPIs match.

At 390 the dashboard showed 314px of horizontal overflow right after resizing from 1024 within the same page. On a fresh load at 390 there is 0px overflow. This is resize residue, likely chart reflow (improvement).
The phone 44px target sweep found only the 1x1 'Skip to content' link (sr-only). axe found 0 serious/critical issues on the 390 list and ticket views.

Re-verification of the iteration_13 bugs: fixed are the #GB19790 values ($160/$82), the Edit/Duplicate/Create dialogs, refund validation, → / ← navigation, sort control, delete confirm, the Agent lock on shared views, the Ask AI context and source chips plus Loop facts, the shortcuts modal, tablet list + conversation with a Details sheet, and phone views sheet plus Ask AI in ⋯. Not re-verified: handover stale/refresh state (superseded) and Cc/Bcc (outside the Phase 11 composer spec).
A first run accepted a private 'Sizing help' view alongside the shared one. Later runs rejected it with the duplicate error, so this is treated as flaky or harness timing, not a bug.

action_items.detail: The preview URL returned HTTP 429 (rate limit) after many runs. The checks' saved URLs were switched to http://localhost:3000. The early runs through the preview URL had already passed the ingress path.
